department: Department of Biostatistics and Data Science, School of Public Health and Tropical Medicine

deadline.value: Final deadline December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027 entry through SOPHAS.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required and is not considered.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for any program, and GRE scores are not considered as part of the application review process.

gre_subject.value: The GRE is not required and is not considered.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is not required for any program, and GRE scores are not considered as part of the application review process.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 4.5 (new scale), IELTS 6.5, or Duolingo 120 is required.
toefl_min.quote: Scores of 4.5 or higher on TOEFL, an IELTS band of 6.5, or scores of 120 or higher on Duolingo are required.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic band 6.5 overall; TOEFL 4.5 (new scale) or Duolingo 120 also accepted.
ielts_min.quote: Scores of 4.5 or higher on TOEFL, an IELTS band of 6.5, or scores of 120 or higher on Duolingo are required.

english_waiver.value: Waived with a WES evaluation showing English was the language of instruction for a degree of two years or more.
english_waiver.quote: Can provide a WES credential evaluation verifying that English was the language of instruction for a two-year degree or longer

supervisor.value: Advised to contact potential faculty advisors before or during the application.
supervisor.quote: we highly recommend reaching out to potential faculty advisors prior to or during the application process

funding.value: Complete applications by the deadline are considered for funding opportunities.
funding.quote: All applications that are submitted and complete by the deadline will be considered for funding opportunities

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's degree from a regionally accredited institution; no master's is listed.
entry_route.quote: we are only able to accept bachelor's degrees from regionally accredited universities and colleges

notes: School of Public Health & Tropical Medicine with its own SOPHAS application. The $75 application fee on the page is listed for certificate programs only, so no PhD fee is stated. The Biostatistics & Data Science department offers this PhD; no separate data science PhD exists.
